correctness.rationale: For even q the paired letters in positions 2j,2j+1 have opposite parity, forcing every even-position centered prefix height divisible by four. An odd-order cube would make four endpoint heights an arithmetic progression with odd common difference but with the even endpoints two steps apart and both divisible by four, contradiction. For q=4 all 4-aligned heights are zero. Orders divisible by four admit a=0. Orders n=4v+2 have explicit a=4(4^h-(2v+1)-v) with sufficiently large parity-chosen h; base-four digit complement makes both nonaligned endpoint heights zero. The independent local checker verified the used identities and families of witnesses, but finite computations are not the proof.
